description: All four elements. Protocol, execution, worker host and control surface, each from its recorded revision. This is the maintainer-shaped stack, not yet a one-command newcomer install.

components.role: protocol: schemas, validators, templates, acceptance harness, checkers
components.why: the executor loads protocol validators from the pinned checkout and the acceptance harness lives here

components.role: worker host: /v1 attempts API and governed provisioning
components.why: the production dispatch path targets the worker host

components.role: execution system: dispatch, leases, verify, integrate, recovery, RETURN
components.why: the loop that turns briefs into accepted artifacts

components.role: control surface: boards, sessions, activity, launcher front-end
components.why: the full profile includes the coordination interface; the protocol itself never requires it

env.name: WORKFLOW_SRC
env.note: pinned workflow checkout for the executor suite

env.name: HYVV_SRC
env.note: pinned hyvv checkout for the executor suite

env.name: REQUIRE_WORKFLOW
env.note: fail closed when the workflow checkout is missing

env.name: REQUIRE_HYVV
env.note: fail closed when the hyvv checkout is missing

env.name: ACCEPTANCE_MODE
env.note: docker or local for the cold-start acceptance run

env.name: ACCEPTANCE_ACDD
env.note: require fails without an ACDD-capable bundlebees

env.name: BUNDLEBEES_ALLOW_WEAK_UNSHARE
env.note: documented-unsafe override; never set in production

ports: loopback-only default across all four elements: workers dial out, nothing needs an inbound port from the open internet
auth_posture: the human owner holds every gate (merge, tag, release, deploy, budgets, enrollment); HMAC key files at 0600 sign coordinator records; provider keys live in user-only 0600 files, never in config or git; the verify sandbox carries no coordinator credentials
cannot_do: cannot be installed by a stranger with one command yet: the Orbit runnable-by-anyone path is in progress (docs/15) and bundlebees hardening is untagged on main
cannot run contract-aware verify from a tagged release: ACDD dispatch, verify and integrate live on the bundlebees feat branch under review, not main
cannot run the real-model recovery or wake-up paths unsupervised: those are env-gated, supervised-only runs
cannot skip human authority anywhere in the loop: silence is not consent and a relayed yes is not approval
cannot prove a live Windows worker host or a cross-machine run: both are recorded limitations
